candidates.change_summary: Replace the supportsInterface function body to always return true
Replace the supportsInterface function body to always return false
Replace the OR'd interfaces check with a check for only IERC165 interface id
Replace the OR'd interfaces check with a check for only IERC1155 interface id
Replace the OR'd interfaces check with a check for only IERC1155MetadataURI interface id
Remove the call to super.supportsInterface, checking only the two ERC1155 interfaces
Replace the body with a delegate call to super.supportsInterface only
Remove the require check that account is not the zero address, so balanceOf(address(0), id) returns the token balance stored under address(0) instead of reverting.
Replace the balance lookup with a constant return of zero to make balanceOf always return 0.
Change the return expression to return balance for a fixed different id (e.g., id+1) so the caller gets the wrong token balance.
Swap the mapping keys to read _balances[account][id] instead of _balances[id][account], which returns an unrelated mapping slot (likely zero).
Return the sum of the requested balance plus one, always inflating the reported balance by 1.
Replace the account validation with a check on id != 0, so balanceOf reverts for id=0 instead of for zero-address account.
Return type(uint256).max unconditionally, making the reported balance the maximum possible value.
Delete the zero-address require check, allowing balance queries for address(0) which may return non-zero balances if previously minted to address(0).

Replace 'ids.length' with 'ids.length + 1' in the length check of the loop condition break, making the loop revert due to out-of-bounds access when accounts and ids arrays have equal lengths, but implicitly changing behavior when they have same length by reverting instead of succeeding. Wait, to get a non-revert difference, we need an edit that changes return values without reverting. Alternatively, replace the assignment to batchBalances[i] with a constant value.
Replace 'balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i])' with '0' so that all returned balances are zero, changing the observable return value of balanceOfBatch without reverting.
Replace the loop increment '++i' with 'i += 2' which skips every other element, leaving every other balance unset (zero) and returning a different array of balances.
Replace 'accounts.length' with 'accounts.length - 1' in the loop condition, skipping the last element and returning 0 for the last balance, changing the observable return.
Replace 'ids[i]' with 'ids[i] + 1' inside the call to balanceOf, querying a different token ID than requested, thus returning a different balance for each account.
